questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Automata Theory, Deterministic & Nondeterministic Finite Automata (DFA, NFA)
questions.text: Define Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA) as a 5-tuple $(Q, \Sigma, \delta, q_0, F)$. Design a minimal DFA that accepts the language $L = \{w \in \{0, 1\}^* \mid w \text{ contains '010' as a substring and does not end with '11'}\}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Automata Theory, Deterministic & Nondeterministic Finite Automata (DFA, NFA)
questions.text: Explain the Subset Construction algorithm for converting a Non-Deterministic Finite Automata with $\epsilon$-transitions ($\epsilon$-NFA) into an equivalent DFA. Convert the given $\epsilon$-NFA into DFA and minimize the DFA using the Table-Filling (Myhill-Nerode) algorithm.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Regular Expressions, Regular Languages & Pumping Lemma for Regular Sets
questions.text: State Arden's Theorem ($R = Q + RP \implies R = QP^*$). Find the regular expression corresponding to a given 3-state transition system using Arden's theorem.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Regular Expressions, Regular Languages & Pumping Lemma for Regular Sets
questions.text: State the Pumping Lemma for Regular Languages. Prove using the pumping lemma that the language $L = \{0^n 1^n \mid n \ge 0\}$ and $L = \{a^p \mid p \text{ is a prime number}\}$ are not regular.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Context-Free Grammars (CFG), Parse Trees, Ambiguity & Normal Forms (CNF, GNF)
questions.text: Define Context-Free Grammar (CFG) and ambiguity. Show that the grammar $S \to aSb \mid ab \mid SS$ is ambiguous by constructing two distinct parse trees and leftmost derivations for the string $aabbab$. Convert the CFG into Chomsky Normal Form (CNF).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Automata Theory, Deterministic & Nondeterministic Finite Automata (DFA, NFA)
questions.text: Define Pushdown Automata (PDA) as a 7-tuple. Design a deterministic PDA (DPDA) that accepts the language $L = \{w c w^R \mid w \in \{a, b\}^*\}$ by empty stack and by final state. Show the step-by-step instantaneous description (ID) trace for the string $abacaba$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Turing Machines, Variants of Turing Machines & Church-Turing Thesis
questions.text: Define standard Single-Tape Turing Machine (TM) as a 7-tuple. Design a Turing Machine that decides the language $L = \{0^n 1^n 2^n \mid n \ge 1\}$. Draw the complete state transition diagram and show the sequence of tape configurations for the input $001122$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Turing Machines, Variants of Turing Machines & Church-Turing Thesis
questions.text: State and prove that the Halting Problem of Turing Machines ($HALT_{TM}$) is undecidable using Cantor's diagonalization argument. Explain Post's Correspondence Problem (PCP) and Rice's Theorem.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Regular Expressions, Regular Languages & Pumping Lemma for Regular Sets
questions.text: Explain the Chomsky Hierarchy of Languages: Type 0 (Unrestricted / Recursively Enumerable), Type 1 (Context-Sensitive), Type 2 (Context-Free), and Type 3 (Regular) with their corresponding grammar production rules and recognizing automata models.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Regular Expressions, Regular Languages & Pumping Lemma for Regular Sets
questions.text: State the Pumping Lemma for Context-Free Languages. Prove that the language $L = \{a^n b^n c^n \mid n \ge 1\}$ is not context-free.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Turing Machines, Variants of Turing Machines & Church-Turing Thesis
questions.text: Design a Turing Machine to compute the 2's complement of a binary string on tape. Explain variations of Turing Machines: Multi-tape TM, Non-deterministic TM, and Universal Turing Machine (UTM).
